description: List parliamentary codes, identifier formats, historical committees and political groups, or coverage limitations. Topic organizations with organization_ids resolves the organization IDs other tools return, decimal (org/5154) or code (org/IMCO, org/S-D, org/ep-9), into published names and dates; a question's addressee_ids do not resolve here (COM is the Communist and Allies Group). Per-item found false means no detail was published, as for a code in the wrong case. Lookups page the supplied IDs; repeat the same ID list with page.next_offset. Committees and political groups keep historical coverage. No snapshots; missing end dates do not establish current status.

language.description: EU ISO 639-1 language, any case; default en; text is never translated.

limit.description: Items per page; default 20. Local collections return every requested row, with no output-size cap. Caps: 1000 reference entries or 20 organization lookups; a larger limit narrows to the cap with a notice.

organization_ids.description: Organizations only (required, nonempty); order and duplicates kept, at most 20 looked up per page.

items.description: Decimal ID or case-sensitive code (IMCO, S-D, ep-9), bare, after org/, or in the https://data.europarl.europa.eu/org/ URI; labels such as S&D are rejected.

topic.description: Reference topic; organizations requires organization_ids, which other topics reject.

name: euparl_list_reference

available.description: Whether the source array was published; a published empty array counts.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `invalid_mode_fields`: organizations lacks organization_ids or another topic supplies them. `invalid_filter`: A nonblank language or organization identifier is unsupported. `upstream_rejected`: Parliament rejects the validated request. `upstream_rate_limited`: Parliament rate limiting outlasts the retries. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

items.description: Reference entry; organization identities are not inferred query codes.

code.description: Published identifier or supported query token.

description.description: Accepted spelling, source family or coverage explanation.

end_date.description: Published interval end date; absence does not establish current status.

found.description: Lookup result; false only for HTTP 204 or 404.

label.description: Published label: a corporate body label, or the label of a political group code in mep_filters (mul).

organization_id.description: Supplied ID or code on lookup results, trimmed, without org/ or the URI origin, case unchanged.

source_url.description: Public organization URL on lookup results.

notice.description: Publication, language fallback, empty-result or continuation guidance.

has_more.description: True when more matches exist or cannot be ruled out.

limit.description: Effective page size after caps and the search window.

next_offset.description: Offset of the next page; absent at the search-window boundary even when has_more is true.

snapshot.description: Pass back with next_offset to continue this local collection.

totalCount.description: Exact total; only when published or counted over the whole collection.

truncated.description: True when this page holds only part of the collection.

title: List parliamentary reference data
